details: Bitcoin is currently consolidating around $84,000, having recently retreated from an eight-month high of $87,397 reached on September 21. This price action is supported by significant inflows into US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), which have attracted over $2.25 billion this week, marking the highest weekly inflow since October 2025. Macroeconomic factors, including a Federal Reserve rate hike, continue to influence market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Near $84K Amid Strong ETF Inflows

details: Bitcoin's market dominance has fallen below 60% this week, even as its price increased by 3.3%. This decline in dominance signals strength in the altcoin market, with several major altcoins outperforming Bitcoin. Notable gainers include Litecoin (23.7%), Cardano (12.7%), Dogecoin (12.0%), Chainlink (11.9%), Stellar (11.2%), XRP (10.4%), and Solana (9.3%). Uniquely, this shift occurred alongside $2.4 billion in Bitcoin ETF inflows.
title: Bitcoin Dominance Dips Below 60% as Altcoins Outperform BTC

details: The SEC staff provided crucial guidance on September 25, 2026, stating that staking Ethereum (ETH) does not classify the tokens as securities. This announcement offers a degree of regulatory clarity for the Ethereum ecosystem. Currently, approximately 1.68 million ETH, valued at around $4.5 billion, are queued for staking, suggesting a significant demand for participation in the network's proof-of-stake mechanism, with new stakers facing about a one-month wait.
title: SEC Staff Confirms Ethereum Staking Not a Security

details: Solana's significant Alpenglow consensus upgrade has been activated on testnets, aiming to drastically reduce transaction finality times to an estimated 100-150 milliseconds from the current 12.8 seconds. Separately, Solana validators have narrowly approved a proposal to double the network's disinflation rate. This change is projected to remove approximately 19 million SOL, valued at around $2.2 billion, from the planned issuance over the next six years.
title: Solana Alpenglow Upgrade Live on Testnets, Disinflation Rate Doubled

details: Decentralized oracle network Chainlink has formed a strategic partnership with Infosys, a global IT leader that supports banking and payment infrastructure for over 1.7 billion customer accounts. This collaboration aims to accelerate institutional on-chain finance by integrating Chainlink's technology, including its Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP), with Infosys's systems to create joint solutions for tokenized assets, payments, and settlements.
title: Chainlink Partners with Infosys for Enterprise Blockchain Solutions

details: XRP is trading around $1.55, showing signs of recovery after a strong weekly rally. The cryptocurrency is benefiting from institutional ETF inflows, which contribute to buy-side pressure. However, the market is closely watching for potential impacts from the recent Bitget exchange hack and the scheduled release of up to 1 billion XRP from escrow on October 1st, which could introduce selling pressure.
title: XRP Recovers to $1.55 Amid ETF Inflows, Monitors Bitget Hack Concerns
